name: riderDelta
meaning: The rider's displacement this frame along the carpet axis (MSG_MODIFY_MOVE delta.x or delta.z); its sign gives the drive direction and |delta| scrolls the belt.

name: timerMs
meaning: Cooldown after release (0x400) or the fast-roll limit (0x800); decremented by g_dtMs in states 3 and 5.

name: ratio
meaning: RATIO*4096/10 (RATIO=500 in Lvl-13). Written by Init, never read by the class code.

name: camera
meaning: CAMERA property resource {u16 a; s16 b,c,d; pos at +8}, used by Camera_StartScripted while a non-frozen rider is on the belt.

name: topBox
meaning: Model box 0 + pos, flattened to the top face and extended 50 upward, inset 50 on x and 150 on z. Used for the rider search and the x/z containment test. Computed only in Init.

name: collBox
meaning: Model box used for CustomCollide and the ground query: the last box whose flags lack 0x40000000 (axis 1) or have it (axis 0).

name: rider
meaning: The object riding the belt (FindRider); receives 0x18/0x19/0x44/0x4C.

name: targets
meaning: TARGET..TARGET5 objects (RCarpetMobiles); msg 0x68 MOVING at Init, msg 0x47 speed while rolling.

name: center
meaning: Belt centre: x and z are the topBox midpoint; y is never written. The rider is pulled here.

name: motorSound
meaning: Channel of belt sound 0x8E (rate 0x1000, or 0x2000 in the fast state).

name: rollRot
meaning: Rotation copied to rot when the rider's facing flips: rot at Init, with y (+0xae) rewritten by FaceRider.

name: riderSpeed
meaning: The rider's velocity along the axis (MSG_MODIFY_MOVE vel.x or vel.z in u/s), 0 when its delta is 0. Thresholds: 250 Wolf / 150 other to roll, 700 fast.

name: axis
meaning: 0 = the belt runs along x (facing about 0x400/0xC00), 1 = along z (facing about 0/0x800).

name: rcFlags
meaning: RollingCarpetFlags: 1 scripted camera active, 2 rider registered (MSG_RIDER_ADD sent).
